title: fix: route Kontext to Azure East US
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Routes `kontext` to the supported `myceli-prod-eastus` FLUX.1 Kontext deployment.
- Uses the existing East US production credential and Azure’s documented `services.ai.azure.com` endpoint.
- Sends the canonical `FLUX.1-Kontext-pro` model identifier for generation and editing.
- Fixes the outage caused by Azure retaining a stale Sweden deployment while no longer supporting the model in that region.
- Verified with live generation and edit requests (both HTTP 200), TypeScript typecheck, and 52 focused image tests.

gist.headline: Kontext finds its way east
gist.blurb: The Kontext route wandered into a retired Swedish deployment and found the lights off. Polli pinned a fresh map to East US, where generations and edits are buzzing again.
gist.summary: Rerouted the Azure FLUX.1 Kontext integration to the supported myceli-prod-eastus deployment using Azure's services.ai.azure.com endpoint and the canonical FLUX.1-Kontext-pro model identifier.
gist.impact: Image generation and editing requests using Kontext now reach the working East US Azure deployment and return successful results again.
gist.visual_concept: Depict a cozy pixel-art map room where Polli, dressed as a tiny postal navigator, redirects a glowing route from a faded Sweden sign toward a flourishing East US server garden. A retro Azure-like terminal displays the simple route label "EAST US" while code-plants bloom around the now-connected FLUX Kontext machine, representing restored generation and editing traffic.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, a cute yellow bee with dark brown stripes, pink cheek blush, light blue wings, and a tiny navigator scarf, happily pinning a glowing route from a faded Sweden map marker to a thriving "EAST US" retro server garden; a CRT terminal shows "FLUX KONTEXT" while code-plants and flowers bloom around it. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, nostalgic but beautiful.
